title: Independent verification: complete PR1563 cancelled-return graph and frontier
body:
PR1563's terminal return cancellation changes the interval graph audited by earlier canonical-reset work. This adds a separately implemented, source-bound audit of the **complete changed graph and its 35-point cost/cap frontier**. All checks agree with the predecessor; no discrepancy or new construction is claimed.

**Status: independent finite verification; no new kappa or selected-supplier adoption.** Only `research/independent-cancelled-return-graph/` is added.

The verifier imports no predecessor executable. It independently emits the documented instruction words, derives cut states by chronological eager execution and literal inverse execution, propagates basis-column traces, and solves Bellman costs from the opposite endpoint. A separate scalar Fraction evaluator covers every fused terminal edge in both contexts.

Coverage: **1,431 intervals; 5,618 contextual executions; all 53 terminal edges; 2,332 Fraction terminal columns; 1,618 cap decisions; all 35 frontier points; and all 42 published frontier/cap schedule records (37 distinct words)**. Thirty-seven terminal edges occur in none of those schedule records. A complete 128-partition eight-child/two-pair control and 14 semantic rejection controls support the decomposition and cost accounting. Six external tests reject actual source/pin/certificate corruptions and verify optimized read-only relocation and deterministic regeneration.

The complete graph digest matches PR1563 exactly. At cap 4096, its full word is corroborated at **2,222 instructions and peak 3,958**; the unrestricted minimum in the stated class remains **2,206 at cap 4,116**. The graph represents `2^52` contiguous partitions through the scoped decomposition proof; this is not a replay of that many words or a formal proof of the multiplication theorem.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-cancelled-return-graph
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-cancelled-return-graph outcome=completed`.

Local verification passed on CPython 3.12.13 / macOS 27.0.1 arm64. Optimized CPython 3.14.5 rebuilt byte-identical certificate content. The registered replay, all six package tests, 20 repository research-workflow tests, five selected-record tests, baseline source bindings, actual/transitive source Git-object comparisons and staged whitespace checks pass. Full selected cold replay, native/physical or rounded admission, the nested recurrence, global recursive precision caps, Lean, independent human review and hosted CI success are unclaimed.

Base: `0a201997097b8a89b638f3a2afcb35db4184c8b2`; contribution: `873c21b10fde388866b9116554719348239a6435`; OS assignment seed **82**, independent verification. Exact source PR1563: `e7d1ebfc3093a704b55c14ea4d10d0d0bdfdd0db`; original PR1537: `407f00df6ca0bf86b455b5640f18ec2f62ee77b9`. Four unchanged source files and all Git-blob/SHA256 pins are retained. Source heads were rechecked unchanged. Refreshed main `858771bcca3b8dd5d4ef4aa682a13cc9b7e23920` retains identical selected-result/guidance bytes; the committed patch merges cleanly.

The final complete overlap snapshot covered 663 open PRs and 280 discussion records without pagination warnings. PR1575 (`20828301c60f4b0581964ac3170694da5b8ce12e`) explicitly excludes this changed graph; PR1563's own finite checks retain their credit. Coverage and limits are recorded in TASK.json/VALIDATION.md; this is not a priority guarantee. [Sprint claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1542#discussioncomment-18914923).

Credit **Hanson Sun / PR1563**, **Sagar Thakrar / PR1537**, **Hanson Sun / PR1552 and PR1575**, **Ross Richardson / PR1287 and PR889**, and the retained PR1227/1203 reader lineage. Selected context retains Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan and PR589/555 attribution. Prepared by **Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in analysis, implementation, testing and writing. One parent agent; no subagents or independent human review. Apache-2.0; upstream, frozen packages, ledger and selected frontier unchanged.
